events.title: Experimenting with Higher Player Counts
events.summary: What should Triarchy’s co-op player cap be?We started by aiming to support 1 to 3 players. This already meant quite a lot of work, especially with game balance - Triarchy is quite different playing solo than playing in a duo or trio. Just modifying health or damage numbers doesn't give a good experience. So instead, we’ve given enemies and bosses new attack patterns, and sometimes even different additional mobs in fights. events.title: Gribbles
events.summary: Savage and scrappy, the Gribbles have established a foothold on a handful of islands. Always be cautious around Gribbles, for where there's one, there's bound to be more… A Gribble stronghold is built with chaotic towers and huts made of wood, bone, leather, and whatever junk they can scavenge. The watchtowers give them vantage points to spot incoming pirate raids. They communicate through deep, rhythmic war drums fashioned from stretched hides and hollowed bones. events.title: Introducing TRIARCHY — Sail. Hunt. Survive. Together.
events.summary: Introducing TRIARCHY — Sail. Hunt. Survive. Together.Welcome aboard! Today we're announcing Triarchy, our open-world co-op action adventure for 1–3 players set across a drowned archipelago. Sail your ship, explore islands, fight monsters, choose your abilities, and craft legendary gear to hunt for deadly bosses.Join our Discord or chat with us on the Steam Community Discussions, and stay tuned for Steam Playtest coming soon!
